title: Very good introduction to...
text: Very good introduction to different styles of flamenco with skilled dancers and musicians. Nice display in the museum.
author: Kevin_M

title: Great show
text: It was a great show and I would recommend it. We didn’t think of arriving early for seats so I would recommend getting there at least 15 minutes early. Our seats were not ideal.
author: KERSTIN_F

title: Very talented dancers!
text: Excellent show, very talented dancers, however it would have been nice to have some info to explain the dances a little.
author: Claire_W

title: Was great experience,...
text: Was great experience, intimate setting. Would highly recommend to everyone. Museum is also great experience
author: Mary_W

title: Fabulous show
text: What a fantastic authentic and mesmerising show! Totally recommend to everyone, improvisation was incredible thank you for the experience
author: Alison_J

title: Go see this show!
text: The show was exceptional! The musicians and dancers had us memorized. So passionate, so amazing. Loved it and would highly recommend.
author: Angela_Z

title: Flamenco show
text: Fantastic location (central and easy to find).  Great seats and such an amazing show.  Dancers and singers were amazing and the guitarist was superb !
author: ASTLondon

title: Not to be missed
text: Absolutely stunning all round performances by the artistes  - on the guitar, vocal and dances.  Wish it would have lasted a bit longer than the hour.
author: 222deepaka

title: Stunning performance, totally worth it
text: Absolutely enthralling experience! It was amazing to witness the flamenco dance. The dancers were spectacular and the musicians even more. The ambiance was great. Note that you cannot take photos/videos once the performances have started.
author: Shwetha

title: Highly recommend
text: Great performance, well worth the money. The dancing was amazing and the other performers were very talented
author: Emmy
